final_codes.title: Deep vein thrombosis
evidence_quotes: Left calf swollen, warm and tender after a 14-hour bus journey from Mombasa, pain on dorsiflexion.
final_codes.reasoning: The patient presents with classic signs of deep vein thrombosis (unilateral calf swelling, warmth, tenderness, and pain on dorsiflexion) following prolonged immobility (14-hour bus journey). Per GDL-021, this pattern strongly points to suspected deep vein thrombosis.
